index_file.description: Path to the SWISH++ index file.

temp_directory.description: Directory used for temporary files during indexing.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the search daemon.

extract_filter.description: Whether to extract metadata from files.

search_background.description: Whether to search in the background.

stem_words.description: Whether to stem words for matching.

store_word_positions.description: Whether to store word positions for phrase searches.

associate_meta.description: Whether to associate meta tags with results.

results_max.description: Maximum number of results to return.

words_near.description: Number of words near each other to consider a match.

threads_max.description: Maximum number of threads for indexing.

threads_min.description: Minimum number of threads for indexing.

title_lines.description: Number of lines to use for document title.

word_percent_max.description: Max percent of words to skip.

user.description: User to run search daemon as.

group.description: Group to run search daemon as.

exclude_files.description: List of shell patterns for files to exclude from indexing.

exclude_meta.description: List of meta tags to exclude from indexing.

extract_meta.description: List of meta tags to extract.

exclude_class.description: List of CSS classes to exclude (for HTML).

filter_attachments.description: List of attachment filters. Items is a flat map of pattern and command.

filter_files.description: List of file filters. Items is a flat map of pattern and command.

include_files.description: List of include file definitions. Items is a flat map of module and patterns.

include_meta.description: List of meta name mappings for IncludeMeta.
